scenarios.name: anchored_delegation
scenarios.note: The delegator anchors a seal of the delegated inception, then of the delegated rotation, before each arrives naming its anchoring event. Both are accepted, with the anchoring event stored as their source. An interaction needs no anchor, and a plain rotation of a delegated identifier is refused.

scenarios.name: delegation_waits_for_its_anchor
scenarios.note: A delegated inception naming no anchoring event arrives before the delegator anchors it, and waits. Once the anchoring event is accepted, escrow processing finds it by walking the delegator's log and accepts the delegate.

keripy.message: No delegation seal for delegator EKVb8UcUI4HbnkAG8JqE9AxWi3ToquZXv81fKx_P4RaO on evt 0 dip EI2vAFY6Vfg7ryNSjhTjsN2s62L5WJKLFcBehp0-Ba-J

scenarios.name: delegate_before_its_delegator
scenarios.note: A delegated inception naming its anchoring event arrives before anything of its delegator, and waits; it keeps waiting once the delegator's inception is accepted, and is accepted with the anchoring event.

keripy.message: Missing KEL of delegator EPD6HLVsG13F1LzxV-tVPKJNjYUL9VjxupfRacq4w9zb of evt 0 dip EJAmDDM3GXLL9ju_ELIVxWJooUiMYJ_ciX798Znsm5GB

scenarios.name: wrong_source_is_repaired
scenarios.note: A delegated inception naming the delegator's inception as its anchoring event is refused: an inception cannot anchor. Offered again naming an interaction that holds no seal of it, keripy discards that source and escrows the event, and escrow processing finds the real anchoring event and stores it as the source.

scenarios.name: delegator_forbids_delegation
scenarios.note: The delegator's inception configures do-not-delegate (`DND`); a delegated inception it anchors anyway is refused.

scenarios.name: witnessed_delegate
scenarios.note: A witnessed delegated inception, already anchored and naming its anchoring event, arrives with no witness signature and waits for its witnesses, keeping its source; a witness's receipt completes it.

scenarios.name: delegated_rotation_of_an_undelegated_identifier
scenarios.note: An undelegated identifier rotates with a `drt`. It has no delegator to approve the rotation, and keripy accepts it as an ordinary rotation.
